name: wolf-hunts-sheep
comment: WP-2.3 task 1. b1.7.3 wolves hunt sheep: a wolf (id 0) and two sheep (ids 1, 2) in the fenced stone pen of entity/sheep-shear, no player. EntityWolf.updatePlayerActionState (EntityWolf.java:96-123): an untamed wolf with no target and no path rolls World.rand.nextInt(100) each AI tick; on 0 it takes a random sheep within 16x4x16 (a second World.rand draw) as playerToAttack. EntityCreature then paths to it (World.getPathToEntity) every 20 ticks and calls EntityWolf.attackEntity (:304-324): between 2 and 6 blocks a 1-in-10 leap (motion toward the sheep, 0.4 up), within 1.5 blocks a bite of 2 (EntitySheep.attackEntityFrom = EntityLiving's, the attacker's knock-back). Both sheep die (health 0 at t = 177 and t = 347; one white wool each, EntitySheep.dropFewItems); the wolf's living sounds draw rand.nextInt(3) (EntityWolf.getLivingSound, :70-78). rng_state every tick, entity_state every 2 ticks.
